documents.rulebook_snacks_india.pdf:
Crunchwell Foods - Packaging Labelling Rulebook
Category: Packaged Snack Foods | Market: India | Version 2.1
Purpose: This rulebook describes how Crunchwell interprets the Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and
Display) Regulations, 2020 (FSSAI) and our own brand standards. Every artwork must comply with every
applicable rule below before it is released to print. Where the regulation and this rulebook differ, the stricter
requirement applies. (Illustrative document prepared for the Esko AIForge hackathon - not legal advice.)
Section A - Mandatory declarations
LBL-01 Name of the food: The name of the food must appear on the front panel (principal display panel) and
must match the approved product name exactly.
LBL-02 Net quantity: The net quantity must be declared on the front panel in metric units (g or kg) and must
match the approved net quantity. The numerals of the net quantity declaration must be at least 4 mm high.
LBL-03 List of ingredients: The ingredients must be listed under the heading "Ingredients" in descending
order of weight. The list must match the approved formulation, including the declared percentage of
characterising ingredients (QUID).
LBL-04 Allergen declaration: Allergens present in the product must be declared in a separate "Contains:"
statement immediately after the ingredient list (for example "Contains: Peanuts"). A "May contain" statement
covers cross-contact only and does not replace the "Contains:" statement.
LBL-05 Nutritional information: Nutrition information must be given per 100 g and must include Energy (kcal),
Protein, Carbohydrate, Total Sugars, Added Sugars, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat and Sodium (mg).
All values must match the approved nutrition data.
LBL-06 Veg / Non-veg symbol: Vegetarian products must carry the green vegetarian symbol (a green square
outline containing a filled green circle) on the front panel, close to the name of the food.
LBL-07 FSSAI logo and licence: The FSSAI logo and the 14-digit FSSAI licence number of the brand owner
must be displayed. The licence number must match the approved licence number.
LBL-08 Manufacturer address: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, including the PIN code,
must be declared.
LBL-09 Maximum retail price: The MRP must be declared as "MRP Rs." (or the Rupee symbol) followed by
the amount and the words "Incl. of all taxes".
LBL-10 Date marking: The pack must declare a "Best Before" or "Use By" statement, and provide space for
the batch number and the date of manufacture.
LBL-11 Consumer care: A consumer care telephone number and e-mail address must be printed.
LBL-12 Storage instructions: Storage instructions must be printed for products whose shelf life depends on
storage conditions.
Section B - Claims (brand and regulatory)
CLM-01 Approved claims only: Only claims listed as approved in the product specification may appear on the
pack.
CLM-02 Protein claims: "Source of protein" requires at least 10 g protein per 100 g. "High protein" requires at
least 20 g protein per 100 g.


CLM-03 Health claims: Claims that a food prevents, treats or cures a disease, or boosts immunity, are
prohibited on snack products.
Section C - Design standards
DSN-01 Brand logo: The Crunchwell brand name must appear on the front panel.
DSN-02 Legibility: Mandatory information on the back panel must not be smaller than 1.0 mm x-height.
